title: ICSI Invites Feedback on Proposed Syllabus 2027 Exposure Draft
content:
# ICSI Invites Feedback on Proposed Syllabus 2027 Exposure Draft

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Proposed Syllabus 2027 ka Exposure Draft circulate kiya hai, aur uspar stakeholders se feedback invite kiya hai.

ICSI ka aim hai ki syllabus ko contemporary, future-oriented, aur dynamic professional landscape ke hisaab se align kiya jaaye. Is revision process mein students ki holistic growth, capacity building, knowledge refinement, aur skill enhancement par focus hai.

Yahan kuch key points hain:

*   **Exposure Draft Date:** September 28, 2026.
*   **Feedback Deadline:** Stakeholders ko September 30, 2026, tak apne views aur suggestions submit karne honge.
*   **Key Highlights:** Proposed Syllabus 2027 mein experiential aur application-based learning, emerging technologies jaise AI ka integration, digital tools, aur industry practices par zor diya gaya hai. Iska maksad practical competencies ko strong karna aur academic learning aur professional expectations ke beech ke gap ko fill karna hai.
*   **Purpose:** The syllabus has been developed after a comprehensive review, reflecting the latest developments in financial, economic, social, technological, legal, and regulatory landscapes.
